pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: src/features/home/sub_cockpit/widgets/TriggerSetWidget.tsx:45 re-implements config narrowing with inline typeof checks although narrow.ts:1 declares the one boundary-narrowing door (each widget narrows ONCE there); 7 sibling widgets use it, 5 in this context (TriggerSet, UseCaseSet, ModelTierChoice, ObservabilityPlan, PersonaReady) do not, so a malformed Athena payload is handled differently per widget

techniques.verdict: deviation: the narrowing helpers (recordsOf/textOf/stringsOf/oneOf) hide the decision, but callers reach past them and duplicate the logic with variations
deviation: a change to how malformed widget config is dropped or defaulted lands in narrow.ts plus every hand-rolled widget
realized where used: narrowing yields a domain type once at the edge and JSX renders only that

pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: src/features/templates/sub_generated/shared/vaultAdoptionMatcher.ts:28 hand-holds a service_type alias map for spellings emitted by Rust producers (src-tauri/src/commands/credentials/auth_detect.rs:274 emits 'google_cloud' while the catalog name is gcp_cloud), so the matcher must learn every producer's spelling instead of normalising once at the producer; a new creator path silently fails auto-detect until this map is edited

techniques.verdict: deviation: one class of change (a credential spelling) is scattered across producer and TS matcher, and the file's own comment instructs editing the map per new creator path
partial: the matcher's three match paths sit behind a small hasMatchingCredential/findMatchingCredential surface, but the alias knowledge leaks one decision (service_type naming) across two modules
realized: matching and binding derivation are pure functions over passed-in credentials and answers
